title: Paper workspace and in-app PDF reader with evidence highlight
description: Resizable split workspace: PDF reader (react-pdf/pdf.js, lazy) and Details (bibliography, provenance, metadata edit, attach PDF) on the left; conversation on the right. Mobile Chat/PDF/Details tabs. Citation chips jump to the page and highlight the cited excerpt.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready paper, when the workspace opens, then the PDF renders lazily with page count and zoom, and the conversation pane is usable without choosing a tab.

Given a citation chip for page 2, when clicked, then the reader scrolls to page 2 and marks the matching text spans; when no text matches, then it still jumps and says the passage could not be highlighted.
Given a metadata-only paper, then the reader shows an attach-PDF dropzone and the composer explains why asking is disabled.
Given 390px width, then Chat, PDF and Details are tabs and a chip tap switches to PDF at the cited page.
test_cases: DetailsPanel RTL: provenance, dirty-only PATCH, metadata-only gate
e2e/workspace.spec.ts E2E-03, citation jump, mobile tabs
